_about: THE ONE PLACE a main character's real height is typed (inches). Tom is the baseline: his standing walk figure is 42 rows on screen, and everyone is drawn at 42 x inches / 71 next to him. The walk bakes (tools/sprite-bake/walk_sheet_frames.py) and the game's draw scales (data/walk-scale.js, written by tools/sprite-bake/heights.py write) both come from this file. After changing a number: rebake that walk (walk_splice.py), run heights.py write, then python3 tools/heights_test.py. Townsfolk heights live in tools/art-library/npc-prompts.js (ft).
